expected_level_description: You can: - prepare contracts, variation letters, and employment checks accurately - process changes in the HR and payroll system against deadlines - answer routine questions from managers and staff about HR processes
You can: - explain the main people policies and where to find them - recognise when a question needs advice from an HR adviser
You can: - explain the main stages of conduct, capability, grievance, and attendance procedures - take accurate notes at formal meetings and keep case records confidential
You can: - enter workforce data accurately in the HR system - explain why workforce data must be accurate and kept confidential
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team
You can: - treat colleagues, patients, and the public with dignity and respect - follow equality and inclusion policies
